activity.notes: Roger II received the royal title in 1130 and was crowned King of Sicily at Palermo at Christmas that year. He remained king until his death in 1154. ATLAS records the Kingdom of Sicily sovereign reign rather than his earlier County of Sicily or ducal claims.

sources.title: Roger II, King of Sicily — Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani describes Roger II's acquisition and coronation of the royal title in 1130 and his death in 1154.
